name: session-prs
description: Band above the prompt that tracks the PRs your session used, with status, CI, review and comments, and buttons to review, fix CI, copy and dismiss.

fixSkill.title: Fix-CI skill
fixSkill.description: Name of the skill to run on a PR whose CI fails, for example ci-fix. The fix CI button sends "/<skill> <PR link>". Leave empty to be told how to set it when you press the button.

reviewSkills.title: Review skills
reviewSkills.description: Skills that review a PR, separated by commas, for example code-review, my-plugin:security-review. The review button runs each one on the PR, one after the other, sending "/<skill> <PR link>". Leave empty to be told how to set it when you press the button.

iconStyle.title: Button style
iconStyle.description: icons (default) draws Material Design icons from a Nerd Font, which Ghostty ships and other terminals need installed. words draws plain words instead.

links.title: Clickable links
links.description: auto (default) makes the repo, PR number, status and CI clickable only in terminals that support links (Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm, VS Code, kitty and others). Other terminals, such as macOS Terminal, would print each full URL under the text, so auto draws plain text there. Set on or off to force it.
